newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Polkomtel has over 100,000 subscribers.
newsitem.headline: Polish Polkomtel has over 100,000 subscribers.

text.p: Polish digital cellular phone operator Polkomtel SA, which markets its system under Plus GSM brand, has over 100,000 subscribers, the company's president Wladyslaw Bartoszewicz said on Monday.

Polkomtel, one of Polish two GSM system operators, started operating in October 1996. It groups Danish Tele Danmark, U.S. AirTouch Communications, Polish copper concern KGHM SA, the Plock oil refinery and the National Power Grid (PSE).
Bartoszewicz added the system was currently available for 40 percent of the country's population.

He also confirmed earlier predictions that by the end of century Polkomtel was likely to have a million clients. Earlier Polkomtel said it expected to have more than 200,000 clients by the end of 1997.
Bartoszewicz also said the company had introduced a short message system last week, enabling Plus GSM clients to send up to 160-letter text messages.
